$comment: The step-500 of every ramp, READ FROM THE FIGMA `Primitives / Palette`
Why both exist: the manifest records what the palette was generated from;
this file records what the design file currently HOLDS. They agreed when
this was captured, and that agreement is worth being able to re-check
rather than assume — a Figma edit to a 500 would silently make the
committed palette and the design file disagree, and the swatch sheet would
Re-capture by reading color/<ramp>/500 out of the Palette collection.
Then: cargo run -p harmoni-core --features swatch-sheet --example swatch-sheet

why: Neutral is NOT produced by generate_brand_pair — it comes from the
neutral module, which takes a different input shape including the
hue-tint mode. Its 500 also differs between light and dark, where every
chromatic ramp shares one seed across both. Feeding it through the brand
generator would produce a plausible ramp that is NOT the shipped neutral,
so it is excluded here explicitly rather than omitted quietly.

$notGenerated.brand-alpha: The seed at the alpha curve's opacities, not a generated ramp.
$notGenerated.neutral-alpha: As above, anchored on the neutral veil.
$notGenerated.neutral-alpha-inverse: The opposite theme's veil; a Figma-only mirror family.
